title: Summit Qualifier Rate on the Extension Fee — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Summit benefit term.** The extension-fee member rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers follows the customer's Summit tier and qualifying dollars this year in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program:

- **0.70** for a Summit Gold member whose qualifying dollars this year have reached the qualifying-dollars threshold of Summit Gold in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program;
- **0.85** for a Summit Silver member whose qualifying dollars this year have reached the qualifying-dollars threshold of Summit Silver;
- **1** for every other customer.

"Reached" means at least equal to the threshold of the member's own tier. The records read are the member's tier and qualifying dollars this year on the Summit membership, and the threshold the program sets for that tier.

## Combinations

| Summit tier | Qualifying dollars this year have reached the tier's threshold | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Gold | yes | 0.70 |
| Summit Gold | no | 1 |
| Summit Silver | yes | 0.85 |
| Summit Silver | no | 1 |
| Summit Member, Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond, Summit Chairman, or no Summit membership | not applicable | 1 |

## Threshold edge (hypothetical threshold of 12,000 qualifying dollars)

A Summit Gold member with 12,000.00 qualifying dollars this year has reached the threshold, so the rate is 0.70. With 11,999.99 the threshold is not reached, so the rate is 1. The threshold figure is illustrative. The actual figure is the one the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets for the tier.
